title: Matemágico · Atractor extraño
description: docs/animas/matemagico/README.md § Atractor extraño (Aitor 2026-11-25): the pen draws the Lorenz butterfly round the foe, the others' statuses stream into it and follow the Lorenz field on the GPU, and ρ falls until it all spirals into the chest. In the fight tester against three sturdy dogs, one player leading both. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 600; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp = 400; }); });

ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 600; f.timed = {}; delete f.statuses; }); s.foes.forEach(f => { f.timed = { quemado: { level: 2, left: 10, next: 2 } }; }); s.foes[1].timed.cristalizado = { level: 2, left: 20, next: 20 }; s.foes[2].timed.envenenado = { level: 1, left: 20, next: 4 }; })

steps.caption: His skills with Cálculo bought past Maná +1: Atractor extraño, 2 maná

Three dogs at Quemado II (one also full of shards, one poisoned), Combustión bought: the butterfly drawn round the first, the embers, shards and poison of the other two stream into it, and it collapses into the chest
Three Quemado II: the target at IV (Combustión) with the shards and the poison; the others clean

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 600; f.timed = {}; delete f.statuses; }); s.foes[0].timed = { empolvado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 20 } }; s.foes[1].timed = { quemado: { level: 2, left: 10, next: 2 }, cegado: { level: 1, left: 10, next: 10 } }; s.foes[2].timed = { mojado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 20 }, encogido: { level: 1, left: 15, next: 15 } }; })

steps.caption: Reactions on arrival: the target powdered, one dog burning and blinded, one wet and shrunk. The fire that comes meets the powder (¡Estallido!), the water that comes puts the new fire out (¡Humo!), steam where they meet
After the reactions: the target blinded and shrunk, everyone singed by the Estallido
